findings.title: Records panel aria-labelledby target is missing
findings.detail: The records section declares aria-labelledby="archive-records-title", but PanelHeader renders an h2 without that id. Assistive technology cannot resolve the panel's accessible name. Add the id to the corresponding heading or remove the dangling reference.

findings.title: Archive detail aria-labelledby target is missing
findings.detail: The detail section declares aria-labelledby="archive-detail-title", but PanelHeader renders an h2 without that id. This is another dangling accessible-name reference and should be corrected in the owned implementation.
